research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Stripe is focusing on enhancing secure payment processing and fraud detection. They are developing systems for secure token-driven routing of proceeds and methods for identity document fraud detection. Additionally, Stripe is working on embedded user interface elements to streamline API interactions and secure data management for sensitive information. Their research also includes systems for transaction tracing and multi-factor authentication for commerce platforms. These efforts highlight Stripe's commitment to improving online payment security and efficiency.

about_short_description.short_description: Stripe is a financial technology company that provides online payment processing and payment infrastructure for businesses.

product.name: Stripe Payments
product.description: A payment-processing platform for accepting and managing online and in-person payments across multiple currencies and payment methods.

product.name: Stripe Billing
product.description: A billing platform for recurring, usage-based, tiered, and one-time charges, including subscription management and revenue collection.

product.name: Stripe Connect
product.description: A platform-payments service for onboarding accounts, routing funds, and managing payouts for marketplaces and software platforms.

product.name: Stripe Checkout
product.description: A hosted and embeddable checkout interface for collecting online payments with support for multiple payment methods and currencies.

product.name: Stripe Terminal
product.description: A solution for accepting in-person payments through compatible card readers and point-of-sale integrations.

product.name: Stripe Radar
product.description: A fraud-prevention service that evaluates transactions and supports rules for detecting and blocking potentially fraudulent payments.
